page.content:

page.overview:
What is Dho-spawn?

The Dho-Spawn is a type of Great Old One created for the Call of Cthulhu role-playing game.

Dho-Spawn are the larval stages of the Great Old Ones, which are invisible and dwell in another dimension.

Category:Species Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Extra-Dimensional Species Category:Great Old Ones
